y-m-76-08.material:
Akwati guda a masana'antar sassa yana ɗauke da sassa 5,000. Mai duba ya zaɓi 50 ba tare da son rai ba daga akwatin ya bincika, kuma 1 yana da lahani (ƙimar lahani a samfurin 2%). Teburin da ke ƙasa yana nuna 'yiwuwar cewa, idan aka ɗauka ƙimar lahani ta ainihi a akwatin gaba ɗaya ita ce wannan, a cikin sassa 50 da aka zaɓa za a samu masu lahani 1 ko ƙasa' (an riga an lissafa ƙimomin).

y-m-76-01.s.s2.hint.0: A kira farashin kafin VAT da harafi guda (misali x), sannan a rubuta lissafi da ke nuna yadda ake bayyana jimillar ta amfani da x.
y-m-76-01.s.s2.hint.1: Bincika ko ƙara VAT 10% ga wata ƙima da ka zaɓa yana ba da 33,000 won.

y-m-76-01.s.s2.o.d: Idan ba a san farashin kafin VAT ba, ba za a iya nemo VAT ma ba, saboda haka ba za a iya ƙididdigewa daga jimillar kaɗai ba.
y-m-76-01.s.s2.r.d: Za a iya samunsa ta ɗaukar farashin kafin VAT a matsayin abin da ba a sani ba sannan a kafa lissafin “jimilla = farashin kafin VAT × 1.1”.
y-m-76-01.s.s2.explain: Jimilla = farashin kafin VAT + 10% na farashin kafin VAT = farashin kafin VAT × 1.1. Saboda haka farashin kafin VAT = 33,000 ÷ 1.1 = 30,000 won, kuma VAT 3,000 won ne.
